name: Show data root selection better
description:
Whenever I open Rowbly in a directory that does not have rowbly initialized, I am presented with a screen to initialize the repo.

- If the user has existing data roots in their `.rowblyrc.json` file (home folder) then display a list to select a data root with an option at the bottom to initialize a new data root

- When user clicks to init new data root, shows the same onboarding screen for current folder that it shows today.

- The default data root should always be at the top of the list.
